$comment: DESIGN-LED, deliberately. This catalog exists to reproduce the published Material 3 Design Kit, so the kit is authoritative and a divergence is a bug in this code — the opposite of the component-system catalogs in compose-ai-tools, whose own render is the source of truth and where a kit/render divergence is read as the kit being stale. Direction also has teeth beyond reporting: design-parity's Code-to-Canvas push-back is gated on `code-led` plus a `figma` source, so `design-led` makes writing back to the Figma file structurally impossible rather than merely forbidden by convention. See docs/PARALLEL_SWEEP.md.
